name: Stack
description: Stack is a convenience wrapper around Flex for building one-dimensional layouts. It defaults to a vertical flow (direction="column"), with configurable alignment and spacing between items, and supports responsive values. Use it when you just need a simple stack of elements without dealing with the full flexbox API.

props.name: as
props.description: Polymorphic prop to change the rendered element type

props.name: align
props.description: Alignment of items along the cross axis, supports responsive values

props.name: gap
props.description: Shorthand spacing between items, supports responsive values

props.name: rowGap
props.description: Vertical spacing between rows, overrides gap on block axis

props.name: columnGap
props.description: Horizontal spacing between columns, overrides gap on inline axis

props.name: direction
props.description: Main axis direction, supports responsive values
